images.alt: Vergelijking: melk en vast voedsel — Hebreeën 5:12; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Hebrews 5:12–14 contrasts milk for immature learners with solid food for those trained to distinguish good and evil. Photorealistic still life illustrating the metaphor: on a simple first-century wooden table a small plain clay cup of milk on the left and a modest plate of solid bread and cooked vegetables on the right. An unopened ancient scroll lies behind them, visually connecting nourishment to learning. Quiet natural light, no babies, readable text, knives, modern ceramics or lettering. Not a literal dietary command or feeding scene.

images.alt: Vergelijking: dorens en distels — Hebreeën 6:8; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Hebrews 6:7–8 contrasts useful crops receiving rain with land producing thorns and thistles. Photorealistic landscape focused on neglected ground overgrown by prickly thistles and tangled thorn bushes after rain, droplets on plants and dark wet earth under a clearing sky. No person, punishment spectacle or burning bodies. A specific natural illustration of the second half of the agricultural comparison; no writing, no modern fencing, not another lush grain crop image.
